title: On Picture Scroll Event
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Picture field/variable scrolling (scrollbar, mouse wheel, keyboard)

historical_commentary.text: The On Picture Scroll form event is a longstanding, narrowly-scoped classic-forms feature for building custom image viewers/comparators (e.g. linked image panning, wheel-to-zoom); it remains functional in current 4D versions and this note's techniques still apply directly to classic-form picture objects, with no major architectural shift affecting it.
related_updates: No significant replacement — remains a niche but still-supported classic-form image-handling event in current 4D
